game.name: Rise Of Nightmares (Europe, Asia)
game.desc: Rise of Nightmares on Xbox 360 is a first-person action game using the console's Kinect peripheral. Sega's game takes you into the heart of horror in the mansion of a mad scientist who has kidnapped your wife. Use hand-to-hand weapons such as brass knuckles, knives and even a chainsaw. Use any means necessary to fight your way through the hordes of undead that separate you from your beloved.
